title: P1 Inspector: enable full RC coverage producer and repair empty-exclusions handling
body: Cell F3:T2. Empty exclusions are admitted by sensor-inputs.schema.json but rejected as SENSE_INPUT_INVALID:exclusions. Compatible-input retry retains a failed producer; no whole-repository RC coverage report exists. Add supported coverage aggregation for the real declared population in a separate task. Acceptance: measured-file population and sidecar match all admitted source roots, exclusions are explicit, and missing or stale reports never imply coverage success. Evidence: work/rounds/R-0036/reports/evaluation-34a89f84/.
